story: Rui Oliveira initially sets the fastest time and holds the lead for a long period. Threats emerge from his own team with Giaimi close behind and Julius Johansen ultimately claiming the fastest time. Rafael Reis also challenges but finishes third. Final top three: Johansen first, Oliveira second, Reis third.
